title: Add bounded Dependencies roadmap across CLI, API and UI
description: Phase 4, activated after Structure and Timeline verification. Add a read-only dependency edge list shared by CLI, HTTP API and responsive Roadmap UI. Show explicit blockers separately from provider edges using existing workflow semantics. Scope by ticket subtree, retain cross-boundary and inherited ancestor blockers, and disclose truncation at 200 nodes and 500 edges. Exclude completed/cancelled endpoints by default with an explicit history toggle.
why: Deliver the reviewed roadmap plan without regressions in existing project workflows.

acceptance.text: Public API, CLI and project-scoped HTTP share deterministic bounded nodes and edges with strict option validation and stale snapshots
Selected roots retain cross-branch and inherited blockers; provider stage selection matches workflow and explicit edges remain distinct
Dependencies UI supports root filtering, finished history, clear cap and empty states, ticket navigation and project switching at desktop and 320px
Regression suite, public type declarations, scale fixture and browser checks pass without modifying unrelated canonical records

outcome.summary: Delivered bounded Dependencies across CLI, public API, project-scoped HTTP and responsive UI; fixed Roadmap refresh after browser verification.
outcome.verifiedBy: Windows npm run check: 97 passed, 1 optional real-model skip; public types: 0 diagnostics; browser 1280/320px, filters, caps, context, return links, reset and stale recovery; disposable 2000-ticket benchmark.
